/.title: Financing Bot: the loan file, read and cited
/.description: Financing Bot reads a mortgage loan file and returns a decision ready package to your named underwriter, every figure beside its page. Packs from $2,400.

/product.title: How it works: queue, worksheet, condition list
/product.description: Three screens follow one loan file: the queue, the Form 1084 income worksheet with every add back cited, and conditions drafted in your own wording.

/pricing.title: Pricing: three prepaid file packs, one rate each
/pricing.description: 100 files at $24.00, 500 at $22.00, or an Enterprise Block of 2,000 at $18.00. Valid twelve months, deducted on delivery, nothing that renews on its own.

/drafter.title: Condition drafter: draft a list from one scenario
/drafter.description: Describe one loan in six rows and see the condition list it would produce, split prior to doc and prior to close, each row with the page it would cite.

/about.title: About Financing Bot: built in 2026, decided by you
/about.description: Why a file preparation tool was founded in 2026, the cost and defect figures behind it, the line it never crosses, and how it is bought on a card.

/blog.title: Blog: four notes on the underwriting file
/blog.description: Form 1084 add backs worked to the cent, the large deposit letter, prior to doc versus prior to close, and the governance file on every AI tool.

/blog/form-1084-add-backs.title: How the Form 1084 add backs actually work
/blog/form-1084-add-backs.description: A Schedule C borrower, two tax years, lines 13, 12, 30 and 24b, the 24 month average and the AUS difference, added up on the page so you can check it.

/blog/large-deposit-letter.title: The large deposit rule and the drafted letter
/blog/large-deposit-letter.description: The 50 percent and 1 percent thresholds, what a sourced deposit looks like on the page, seasoning across two statements, and the letter's six parts.

/blog/prior-to-doc-prior-to-close.title: Prior to doc or prior to close: conditions an LOS carries
/blog/prior-to-doc-prior-to-close.description: The one question that splits a condition, one document per row, the page it cites, wording that survives QC, and the file that is referred up instead.

/blog/ai-governance-file.title: The governance file a lender keeps on every AI tool
/blog/ai-governance-file.description: Lender Letter LL-2026-04 and Guide Section 1302.8 in plain terms: the inventory, roles, validation on your files, monitoring, and the vendor's pack.

/contact.title: Contact Financing Bot support
/contact.description: Support email, phone, address and hours for Financing Bot. Put the loan number in the subject line and we open the package before we reply.

/cart.title: Cart
/cart.description: Your file packs before checkout: pack, files, validity and line total. Files are deducted only when a package is delivered to your queue.

/checkout.title: Checkout: account, billing, payment, review
/checkout.description: Guest checkout in four sections. Card or ACH debit, one agreement checkbox, auto reorder off by default, and the account created after payment.

/order-confirmation.title: Order placed
/order-confirmation.description: Your order number and what happens next: receipt, activation email, upload, underwriter profiles and condition library.

/terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
/terms-of-service.description: The terms that govern the purchase and use of Financing Bot file packs, the pilot, the web app and the SMS program.

/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy.description: How Financing Bot handles account, order and file data, and the commitment that no mobile information is shared with or sold to third parties.

/404.title: No file at this address
/404.description: The page you asked for is not in the queue. Nothing was deducted.
